title: The Music That Continued
premise_public: During a theater performance, the stage lights failed and the pianist stopped moving her hands. The audience still heard piano music.
solution_summary: The pianist had been miming along to prerecorded audio. The sound system ran on separate backup power, so playback continued when the stage lights failed.

facts.text: The pianist was miming to prerecorded audio.
The sound equipment had independent power.
The lighting circuit failed but audio playback continued.
The audience assumed the pianist was playing live.

acceptable_solutions: The pianist was pretending to play to a recording on a separate sound system.
Music was prerecorded and the speakers had backup power.
The performer was miming; audio kept playing during the blackout.
hints: The sound did not have to come from the performer's hands.
Lighting and sound did not rely on the same power source.
